about: The milestone table of the visual overhaul, read by tools/gate/gate.mjs (each module gets its milestone's entry as ctx.plan).

Taken from docs/visual-overhaul: the run order in 00-README-SUMMARY.md, the fixed shot ids in 16-qa-and-acceptance.md section 4.1 d, the replaceable tests in 19-decisions-and-conflicts.md section 1, and the HUMAN lines of files 02 to 18.
name: the branch is overhaul/mNN-<name>. files: the plan files the README's run order lists. alsoIn: other plan files that give this milestone work, which the README's column leaves out.

shots: the picture ids this milestone may change. The rule (file 16, section 4.1 d): a change in any other shot fails; a declared shot must change, and its pair goes to a person. The wendigo mask pair is never listed: it may not change in any milestone.

A shot is listed only where a plan file says that screen's picture changes at that size (shotsFrom quotes where). Where the plan names no shot, shots is empty and undeclared says what is missing, so that nobody guesses: Brian or Kai fills it in, and the gate prints the change to this file.
replaceable: what file 19 section 1 lets this milestone replace, and nothing else. scope says how much of the file; test: false marks a file that is not a vitest file.

stops: true where the README marks a stop for Brian. human: the human checks this milestone depends on; a result goes in docs/visual-overhaul/human/mNN.md on a line that starts with the check's id. questions: the numbers of file 19 section 2 asked at this milestone.
Changing this file changes what the gate allows: it is under tools/gate/**, so every change is printed as a decision for Brian.
